Strings.server_center.title: Server centre
Strings.server_center.select_host_hint: Select a host on the Hosts page first.
Strings.server_center.subtitle: Manage the SSH hosts used to install and maintain RelaxKonOS servers.
Strings.server_center.empty: No managed hosts have been added on this device.
Strings.server_center.cached_state: The status shown here is the last SSH verification, not a live health check.
Strings.server_center.invalid_host: Enter a valid SSH host, port, and user.
Strings.server_center.host_added: Host record saved. Verify its SSH host key before deployment.
Strings.server_center.host_removed: The local host record was removed. No server, data, login, or SSH credential was changed.
Strings.server_center.load_failed: Unable to read local host records.
Strings.server_center.save_failed: Unable to save the local host record.
Strings.server_center.remove_failed: Unable to remove the local host record.
Strings.server_center.host_key_review: Verify this SSH host-key fingerprint with the host administrator before trusting it:
Strings.server_center.host_key_changed: The SSH host key changed. Deployment is blocked until an administrator confirms it.
Strings.server_center.ssh_failed: Unable to verify SSH. Check the host, account, password, and network.
Strings.server_center.host_key_mismatch: The observed host key does not belong to the selected host.
Strings.server_center.host_key_trusted: Host key saved. Verify SSH again before deployment.
Strings.server_center.host_key_save_failed: Unable to save the SSH host key.
Strings.server_center.save_ssh_password: Save this SSH password securely on this device
Strings.server_center.ssh_verified_saved: SSH host identity verified and the password was saved securely on this device.
Strings.server_center.probe_help: Preflight uploads the fixed deployment launcher, reads OS, architecture, permissions and current installation status, then saves a timestamped SSH verification.
Strings.server_center.tools_unavailable: This client has no configured, trusted deployment tools for the selected platform.
Strings.server_center.probe_succeeded: Host preflight and SSH-side status check completed.
Strings.server_center.probe_failed: Host preflight could not be completed. Check SSH access and the selected host platform.
Strings.server_center.deploy_confirmation: I understand that this operation changes this host; update, repair, and rollback may interrupt the service.
Strings.server_center.unsupported_host: The selected platform does not match a supported target reported by the host preflight.
Strings.server_center.elevation_required: The selected installation mode requires an elevated SSH session or approved sudo access.
Strings.server_center.installation_identity_miss: The existing installation did not report a valid managed installation identity. Update is blocked.
Strings.server_center.release_unavailable: No trusted signed release is available for this host architecture and installation mode.
Strings.server_center.status_missing: The deployment finished, but no authoritative SSH-side status receipt was returned.
Strings.server_center.install_succeeded: RelaxKonOS was installed and verified through SSH. Return to the login window to sign in.
Strings.server_center.update_succeeded: RelaxKonOS was updated and verified through SSH. Sign in again if the existing session was interrupted.
Strings.server_center.deploy_failed: The server operation could not be completed. Its SSH-side receipt can be checked from this host later.
Strings.server_center.uninstall_name: Type the server name to delete data
Strings.server_center.history_load_failed: Unable to read the local operation history.
Strings.server_center.status_mode_missing: The host did not report an installation mode that can be checked safely.
Strings.server_center.maintenance_preflight_fail: The host no longer reports a supported managed installation. This operation is blocked.
Strings.server_center.repair_succeeded: The current installation was repaired and verified through SSH.
Strings.server_center.rollback_succeeded: The previous program version was restored and verified through SSH.
Strings.server_center.uninstall_retained_succeed: The server was uninstalled. Managed data was retained on the host.
Strings.server_center.uninstall_deleted_succeede: The server and managed data were uninstalled.
Strings.server_center.maintenance_failed: The server operation could not be completed. Its SSH-side receipt can be checked from this host later.
Strings.server_center.operation_refreshed: The selected operation receipt was refreshed from the host.
Strings.server_center.operation_refresh_failed: The remote operation receipt could not be refreshed. Check SSH access and try again.
